entries.title: Quilla Emulator Gate
entries.summary: Host script boots CoreGuard_API35 and runs unit + instrumented + smoke tests. On-device Quilla reports emulator presence and smokes Quantum Correlate — she cannot spawn QEMU from the APK.
entries.body: Deadline harness: ./scripts/quilla-emulator-tests.sh (HEADLESS=1 on CI). It starts AVD CoreGuard_API35 via run-emulator.sh, then :app:testDebugUnitTest, :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest (MainActivity launch + Quilla quantum on-device), then smoke-adb.sh. QuillaEmulatorGate.probe() detects ranchu/goldfish fingerprints and runs an idle quantum circuit for the status brief. Magick gate names still label classical math only.
entries.defense: Use the host harness before Play uploads. Treat emulator PASS as silicon proof, not occult assurance. Prefer KVM hosts — software graphics is slow.
